'''Lergo Brazee''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] where he gave out [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] work to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]. He hired one spacer to bring a new set of piloting permits to one of his friends and then asked him to escort a different friend named [[Slyd Shu'ril|Slym Shu'dee]] who was being chased by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Once he had seen he could trust the spacer he paid him to rescue an individual captured by several [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and finally asked him to [[Death/Legends|assassinate]] another Gungan, [[Big Blismo]].
